testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel while its expansion is pinned: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:197:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel while its expansion is pinned ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the expanded 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top ✔ And the Modify panel is visible with its additional commands expanded and pinned ✔ When the user opens the ribbon panel selector ✔ And the user clears Modify in the panel list ✔ Then the Modify panel and its expanded command area disappear ✔ And the panel list remains open with Modify unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify in the panel list ✔ Then the Modify panel returns to the ribbon ✔ And its additional command area is not open ✔ And the panel list remains open with Modify checked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the panel list closes ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional command area ✔ And the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the additional command area closes
